column1: # Interaction rows: a pose plus the keys/console commands that make the retail engine act.
# Same format as shots.tsv; the harness applies `-Keys`/`-KeysAfter` and `-ConsoleCommands` to every row.
# switch_use: the level-1 cantina door switch. Things 56/57 are linked to cog 11 (`00_doorswitch.cog`,
# link 1) at (-4.75,-3.75,-1.10)/(-4.45,-3.75,-1.10). The warp at eye z -1.09 is coords-verified:
# the switch. Round 192/193 pressed every use binding from poses 0.4 to 1.1 units away -- `9`, ENTER,
# E, SPACE, U, MOUSEMIDDLE -- both before and after the console closed (13.5 s of re-acquired input),
# and cog 11 stayed `doorstatus 0` every time. Kept as the reproducible pose for a trigger-based probe.
